name: StandX DUSD
who_can_redeem: StandX documentation describes DUSD redemption by holders through the official portfolio interface, subject to signed orders, minimum amounts, fees and processing. The precise legal holder/issuer redemption claim is not independently established.
redemption_region_notes: No complete country/eligibility list independently established.
redemption_notes: StandX documentation states a standard seven-day redemption processing period and a minimum 10 DUSD request. Contemporary October 15 wind-down reports place the last request and withdrawal date at January 31, 2027. Seven-day processing and submission deadline are distinct; final settlements must be checked separately.
summary: StandX's yield-bearing USD-targeted DUSD, used within its BNB Chain and Solana perpetual trading ecosystem, is in an announced phased wind-down. Minting is reportedly ending and DUSD redemption requests and platform withdrawals are scheduled to close January 31, 2027.
notes: Do not confuse with other assets bearing DUSD ticker. Treat this as limited, not discontinued or failed, while redemption remains scheduled/available. Source review supports redemption methods but not an independent assessment of present reserves or completed payment to all holders.
